submitted.rationale: Index 23 (Co0.23Sb0.77) had the highest measured EQE: 0.034%. Merit rose steadily toward the Sb-rich end: -0.0034% at Co0.68, 0.0063% at Co0.33, 0.034% at Co0.23. XRD at Co0.33 and Co0.19 shows the same single phase set, consistent with CoSb2O6 trirutile plus excess Sb oxide. At Co0.51, extra low-Q peaks point to a mixed phase.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.0063%, five times lower than index 23
Measured EQE was negative (-0.0034%); the Co-rich side is inactive
